offers.t: General Interest in Genomenon for B&H: Share your resume and we'll keep it on file!
offers.sn: Our Company Genomenon is an AI-driven genetic intelligence company on a mission to save and improve lives by making biomedical information actionable. Rare diseases and cancer affect more than 30 million people in the U.S.
Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems.
offers.rq: Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. - Native or near-native fluency in Bosnian - English proficiency 💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)
